note: SH1043 — what the console costs to load, before the first row of content. Read by test/console-size-budget.test.mjs against a built ../shio-app/src/main/resources/public, and printed by `pnpm --filter shio-react run size`. Raise a ceiling deliberately and say why in the commit, the way token-budgets.properties has governed the agent's cost since SH113: this is the same rule for the half of the product a person waits for.
seed: Taken before Blocks BC-BF land console code, so their cost arrives as raises somebody argues for rather than as a baseline nobody set. Measured on this tree: 7473483 raw, 2200187 gzip. The ceilings carry ~4% of room for the reason SH736 gives one gate over — a ceiling set to the measurement refuses the next change instead of measuring it — and `theCeilingsHaveRoomUnderThem` fails when that room is spent rather than letting a raise-to-the-total pass quietly.

index.js.why: the console itself: every route, every widget and every service, because nothing but GraphiQL is split out yet

index.css.why: Tailwind's output plus the design system's own sheet

rolldown-runtime.js.why: the bundler's own module runtime, which every other chunk is loaded through

vendor-graphiql.js.why: SH1044's subject, and the measurement that made this task worth doing: 4.8 MB preloaded on EVERY route for one page whose own chunk is 3 KB. The manual-chunk rule claims any module id containing `codemirror`, and the widget map imports CodeMirror eagerly, so the entry statically imports it. This entry should shrink to nothing when that is fixed

vendor-graphiql.css.why: the same chunk's stylesheet, eager for the same reason and blocking paint

vendor-lib.js.why: React, the router, the design system and the shared libraries the whole console needs
